snippet.title: Dead Meat - Official Trailer (2025)
snippet.description:
Unleash your inner detective in DEAD MEAT - a murder mystery interrogation game where you can ask the suspects literally anything!

Dive into a macabre conspiracy of burgers and billionaires, getting up-close and personal with an eccentric cast of cold-blooded killers - using voice or keyboard.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2628740/Dead_Meat/
